name: Consoleri
tagline: SSH hosts, terminals, and infrastructure maps for DevOps fleets
description: Consoleri is a Windows-first Electron desktop app for SSH host management, terminal multiplexing, connectivity reports, and network topology visualization. The design system captures the dark production UI from v0.4.7 plus the electron-viz density prototype.

logo.notes: Locked mark: flat pointy-top hexagon #f59e0b with circular aperture on ink #0c141f. Same geometry in every SVG/PNG — rebuild via assets/_brand/rebuild-rasters.cjs. Never invent alternate glyphs.

colors.name: Panel
colors.usage: Cards, list rows, modals, connection panel

colors.name: Brand Amber
colors.usage: Logo hexagon, active tab indicator, brand moments

display.notes: App titles and section headers. Production uses system sans — no proprietary display face in evidence.

body.notes: Host lists, form labels, UI chrome. System UI stack by design (Windows-first Electron).

mono.notes: Paths, fingerprints, table headers, terminal, KPIs. Stand-in web font — no .ttf/.otf shipped in source evidence.

voice.tone: Direct and technical — power-tool voice for DevOps engineers. No marketing fluff.
messagingPillars: Terminal multiplexing with clear session chrome
Connectivity reports and network topology at a glance

imagery.style: Dark utility UI, orange hexagon brand mark, production screenshots and empty states — never decorative stock.
subjects: Empty states with the locked mark
imagery.treatment: High-contrast dark chrome; brand amber reserved for the mark and tab indicators; status greens/reds for OK/FAIL only.
avoid: Alternate logo glyphs (C-stroke, 3D cubes, network wireframes)
Light theme as default product chrome

postureRules: 52px icon sidebar; active item gets solid accent fill
Orange 2px indicator on the active tab
Connection panel slides up from the bottom (min-height 240px)
Dense list rows ~34px (28px dense mode) — utility over whitespace
One accent color per screen for primary actions; status colors only for OK/FAIL
